text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
A full tank of Inter
Chivu reunites with Thuram, Lautaro, and the rest of the starters. An unprecedented depth for the overtaking and the cups.
Tresoldi does a devil
The race for the Champions League coup heats up. The player is ready to say yes; Cardinale has decided to invest 60m. Endrick: ‘I’ll stay at Real Madrid.’
Baldini flies high: here’s the Italy that does not lose
Ekhator arrives: Kolo, Woltemade and now a real No.9. Spalletti chooses.
Kean, what a nightmare: there’s another problem. He’ll return in 2027.
Corriere dello Sport
Kerim’s exam
He wants to lead the Juve comeback
Yildiz’s shadow
Alajbegovic, a parallel challenge to Yildiz.
Two goals and two assists in 14 appearances: he gets the spotlight, waiting for the Turkishman, who has been training at Continassa since yesterday and will try to return before 2027.
Como, Kean’s ordeal
New tibia problems: He’s been sidelined for over a month and risks returning at the beginning of 2027.
Allegri has the market at stake
Sprint until Christmas for the relaunch: January coups depend on results.
Gasp, there’s the full Roma
Dybala, Svilar, Kone and Mancini return on Saturday against Parma. Meanwhile, work continues on Malen’s extension.
Chivu hugs Lautaro again
Inter see him return against Atalanta: Thuram recovers too
Tuttosport
Binaghi to Tuttosport: ‘Dear football, I did a revolution.’
Spalletti hire Ekhator
Two encouraging appearances and a penalty-kick goal: the Bianconeri coach wants to test him against Omonia. Agostini, who launched him at Genoa: ‘He moves like Osimhen.’ Relief for Zhegrova and Celik. Yildiz trains with the ball.
Raimondo: ‘Sinisa, Alvini, the Azzurri, the masters and dreams.’
Calafiori awarded: ‘I’ll win with Arsenal again and then return to Roma.’
‘Stadium, let’s move quickly.’
digest_he:
עיתונות הספורט באיטליה מדווחת בהרחבה על ההכנות לקראת פתיחת משחקי הליגה והמהלכים בחלון ההעברות הקרוב. בין היתר, עולה כי טרסולדי נכון לקבל את ההצעה להצטרף למילאן, בזמן שמוVise קיאן סובל מבעיות נוספות בטיביה שעלולות להשבית אותו לתקופה ארוכה.

עוד עולה כי אינטר נערכת עם סגל מלא לקראת משחקי הליגה, ויובנטוס ממשיכה במאמציה לחזק את השורות ולשפר את מיקומה בטבלה תחת הנהגתו של תיאגו מוטה ובהשתלבות השחקנים הצעירים.
